reviews.text: We've been ordering our dog's kibble from here for the last 2 years and it's been super easy to setup the auto subscription. They're very communicative and punctual with delivery.
Always the best service. Lovely products and even better staff !
Really reliable dog food delivery and a great loyalty program!

Paul and team are reliable, helpful and well priced. I subscribe to dog kibble. The system is simple to use. I can skip deliveries as needed but otherwise we get dog food delivered to our door at the same price as, or less than, driving to a big box store to pick it up.
We’ve been getting our dog’s food from Timmie’s for years now. It’s super easy for us as it just auto renews and they deliver it right to my front door every month.

“Extremely Rude and Unprofessional Treatment”.

I brought my dog in for a nail trim, and after only a few minutes, the employee came back out with her, saying my dog had tried to bite her and that she couldn’t handle her. My dog came out completely calm and did not show any aggressive behavior.

I offered to hold my dog myself, but she refused and repeatedly called my dog “very aggressive” in front of other customers. What made it more uncomfortable was seeing her immediately trim another customer’s dog’s nails while they were holding the dog.

I’ve always had good experiences at this location and I’m a regular customer, so this was very disappointing. I understand that some dogs may be difficult during nail trims, but I expected a more professional and respectful approach.
Timmie’s is the best - great customer service and great products!

I'm a big Timmie's fan.  Have taken but my current and passed dogs for grooming services and nail trimming, but my favourite part of their service is the free dog food delivery.  I order when I see I am getting low and then a day or two later like magic it is on my front porch.
I love stopping by the shop or ordering items online. They deliver in the east end and I love the selection they have.
Paul and the team offer nothing but the best in quality products and the premium level service. My dogs are healthier because of Timmie’s.
Such great service from Timmies! They have incredible customer service and deliver our dog food each month to our front door.
Excellent selection of dog accessories (like these jerseys for World Cup!) and food (like Tom & Sawyer which can be hard to find).
They are so friendly and helpful and took my dog immediately for nail trim no hassle great price

They do a great job. Very punctual. The pet treats are high quality and the best price in the area.

We have been to both locations and have no complainta

My family has been going to timmie’s for years and have always had such a wonderful experience. Today i went in and let them know i have my own to cats now on my own for the first time. Paul gave me old food (he can’t sell anymore) and lots of it. Great people and great products. Love Timmie’s.
Great local pet store! Always friendly and welcoming staff. Highly recommend!

Our shy Bernese who is usually scared to leave our neighbourhood actually perks up and enjoys going into Timmie’s, which really says something. She looks so cute and fresh after her full groom. We’re happy we found Timmie’s. Highly recommend!
The place is extremely welcoming and friendly.  My little dog goes there for his grooming and Crystal does a fantastic job.  We love Timmies!!

We’ve been loyal customers of Timmie’s since we got our cavapoo last February. The selection of treats is awesome but it’s the staff that make this place so amazing. Shoutout to Sarah who always remembers the name of our pup when she comes in, and Crystal always gives her the BEST groom. Highlight recommend!

Our go-to spot for grooming and picking up doggie essentials in the neighbourhood. Krystal has been grooming our pup for years, and the quality of work has been consistent - she’s meticulous in her craft, and she handles our typically nervous and barky pup well!
Helpful knowledgeable staff and a fabulous variety of high quality products.
Took my golden retriever here for a teeth cleaning, such wonderful professional service. His teeth look amazing. Highly recommend!
Love Timmie’s and the cute cuts our doggie gets there. Always kind and excellent service!
Been getting my poodles groomed at Timmie’s for years, they’ve been great. All the staff is super kind and helpful, they have a great stick of healthy foods and treats and toys too!
Great shop for pet supplies andf dog grooming. Be sure to ask for Christal
Our go to spot. Many others in area but staff here super knowledgeable. Love dogs. Love pets and always have so much care on recommendations.

This is our local place to take the dogs for grooming and get them special treats. Selection is good, the staff are friendly and knowledgeable and our pups always come back from grooming looking their best selves. Recently, we went there for Santa pics and the whole process couldn’t be more easy and quick! We love that the proceeds go to Save Our Scruff (where we
adopted one of our dogs), plus they turned out amazing - one of the best Santa family photos we’ve ever taken! Highly recommend a visit to Timmie’s for all your pet needs :)

Got our to Timmie’s when we first moved to Toronto earlier this year. Not planning to go anywhere else new.

Crystal is excellent. She has been giving our mini-schnauzer such good grooms that he looks like a show dog when he comes back. She does a brilliant job of bringing out his beard, bow tie and white paws.

Also, they have their own mini-schnauzer Freya who just hangs around. Don’t forget to say hi to her.
Loved how they cut my dog's hair! Looks good from day one and grows out perfectly :) My dog has separation anxiety but has no problem with the groomer! I believe her name was Crystal. Thank you!!
Lovely store & staff
Good prices and great service!
